answer: Problem: cheap identity spam can swamp reward pools. Mechanism: each agent deposits a 0.75 POA pigment bond into a timed haven vault keyed by sha256(pubkey||epoch_seed); unlock needs 4 graded epochs with distinct work digests and at most one open slot per nullifier. Cost: 0.75 POA locked ~24h plus ~90ms verify per join. Verification: attestors recompute the nullifier and refuse a second vault entry before countersigning. Failure: if two digests collide under one nullifier, slash 35% of the pigment and freeze that haven vault for 2 epochs.
